title: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge
public_domain_status: The original Treasury of Scripture Knowledge is public domain.

phase_1_selected_path.title: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge Phase 1 reviewed sample
phase_1_selected_path.public_domain_status: Public-domain source tradition; Phase 1 reviewed sample from archive/source comparison.
phase_1_selected_path.rights_notes: Use this small reviewed sample for Genesis 1-5, Exodus 1-5, John 1-5, Romans 1-8, and Luke 24. Do not treat it as a full TSK import.

crosswire_public_domain_source.title: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge / CrossWire TSK Module
crosswire_public_domain_source.rights_notes: CrossWire's official module information and tsk.conf both identify the TSK module as Public Domain. Import reviewed reference pairs and short source headings only; do not import Bible quotation text.

candidate_download_source.title: KJV Bible Database with Metadata / MetaV CrossRefIndex
candidate_download_source.candidate_license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 according to the repository readme.
candidate_download_source.rights_notes: The repository readme says CrossRefIndex is compiled from R. A. Torrey's public-domain Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, but the repository files themselves are published under CC BY-SA 3.0. Treat this as a source candidate, not unrestricted public-domain app data, until the share-alike implications are accepted or a purely public-domain source file is chosen.

import_notes: Use scripts/prepare-tsk-metav-cross-references.mjs to convert MetaV Verses.csv and CrossRefIndex.csv into the app's JSON import shape. Then run scripts/import-tsk-cross-references.mjs after rights approval.
current_checkout_note: The MetaV source CSV files are not present and must not be used for new rows. The official CrossWire TSK module is the selected public-domain source for new manually reviewed reference-pair batches.
